queries.query: What is the mathematical formulation of Scaled Dot-Product Attention in the Transformer?
expected_documents: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani et al.)
queries.ground_truth_answer: Scaled Dot-Product Attention is computed as Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax((Q K^T) / sqrt(d_k)) V, where queries and keys have dimension d_k and values have dimension d_v.

queries.query: How does the Transformer encoder architecture process representations using self-attention and feed-forward sub-layers?
expected_documents: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani et al.)
queries.ground_truth_answer: The Transformer encoder consists of a stack of N = 6 identical layers. Each layer contains two sub-layers: a multi-head self-attention mechanism and a position-wise fully connected feed-forward network, employing residual connections and layer normalization LayerNorm(x + Sublayer(x)) with output dimension d_model = 512.
